headline.purpose: The single route H1 and current-read statements.

body.purpose: Findings, explanations, and persistent interface copy.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A direct data or workflow action with one clear outcome.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--field-accent, #83bfff); color: var(--field-canvas, #0e1520); font: 700 14px/1.4 "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Aptos", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--field-accent-strong, #a8d2ff); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--field-focus, #9fd0ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--field-border-strong, #62758e); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--field-canvas-raised, #121c2a); color: var(--field-text, #f4f7fb); font: 700 14px/1.4 "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Aptos", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--field-accent, #83bfff); background: var(--field-surface, #182333); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--field-focus, #9fd0ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Evidence Card
components.description: A bounded group of related findings with tonal, not decorative, depth.
components.html:
CURRENT READ

Participation is mixed

Seven of eleven sectors are advancing, while breadth remains uneven.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--field-border, #3f5068); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--field-surface, #182333); color: var(--field-text, #f4f7fb); box-shadow: 0 18px 48px -32px rgba(0,0,0,.78); font-family: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Aptos", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-kicker { color: var(--field-accent-strong, #a8d2ff); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .16em; } .ds-card h2 { margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-card p { margin: 8px 0 0; max-width: 65ch; color: var(--field-text-muted, #b7c3d3); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Labeled Input
components.description: A persistent label and clearly bounded research input.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--field-text-muted, #b7c3d3); font: 700 13px/1.4 "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Aptos", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--field-border-strong, #62758e); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--field-canvas-raised, #121c2a); color: var(--field-text, #f4f7fb); font: 400 15px/1.5 inherit; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--field-accent, #83bfff); outline: 2px solid var(--field-focus, #9fd0ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selected Chip
components.description: A compact selected lens that communicates state through border, surface, and text.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--field-border-strong, #62758e); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--field-surface-raised, #1e2b3d); color: var(--field-text, #f4f7fb); font: 700 12px/1.4 "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Aptos", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--field-surface, #182333); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--field-focus, #9fd0ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation Item
components.description: A current route shown through a raised surface and strong border, not color alone.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; align-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--field-border-strong, #62758e); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--field-surface-raised, #1e2b3d); color: var(--field-text, #f4f7fb); font: 700 13px/1.4 "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Aptos", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--field-surface, #182333); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--field-focus, #9fd0ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Partial Data State
components.description: An honest state panel that preserves available evidence and names the missing surface.
components.html:
Partial market update

The headline is available; historical evidence is temporarily unavailable.
components.css: .ds-state { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 5px minmax(0,1fr); gap: 16px; min-height: 120px; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--field-border, #3f5068); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--field-surface, #182333); color: var(--field-text, #f4f7fb); font-family: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Aptos", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-state > span { border-radius: 4px; background: var(--field-caution, #f3cb69); } .ds-state h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; } .ds-state p { margin: 7px 0 0; color: var(--field-text-muted, #b7c3d3); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Chart Data Disclosure
components.description: The keyboard-reachable values companion to a decision-bearing chart.
components.html:
View chart data
Timestamped values appear here.
components.css: .ds-chart-data { border-top: 1px solid var(--field-border, #3f5068); color: var(--field-text-muted, #b7c3d3); font-family: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Aptos", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chart-data summary { display: flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; color: var(--field-accent-strong, #a8d2ff); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chart-data summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--field-focus, #9fd0ff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chart-data div { padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--field-canvas-raised, #121c2a); font-size: 13px; }

narrative.overview:
Market Diagnostic Dashboard should feel like a calm research instrument: quiet enough to support concentration, structured enough to audit, and direct enough to use under time pressure. It is not a promotional finance site and it should never imply more certainty than the data supports. The interface earns trust by connecting each conclusion to its drivers, values, definitions, freshness, and provenance.

The default page spine is Now → Drivers → Evidence → Definition → Audit. Operational workspaces may add Action, but action must remain visibly governed by the user. Dense evidence is welcome when it has hierarchy; arbitrary card walls, microscopic labels, and decorative dashboard effects are not.
keyCharacteristics: Midnight analytical canvas with crisp, cool surfaces.
Current read first; methodology and raw evidence remain directly reachable.
Asset-family color identifies data, while green, yellow, and red identify condition.
Missingness, staleness, partial coverage, and protected state are visible product states.
Desktop and mobile preserve the same meaning, even when their composition differs.

rules.name: The Identity/Condition Rule
rules.body: Asset-family colors identify what a measure belongs to. Stable, caution, and stress colors communicate its condition. Do not swap those jobs.

rules.name: The Rare Accent Rule
rules.body: Evidence Blue is an orientation tool. If every card glows blue, nothing is oriented.

rules.name: The Twelve-Pixel Floor
rules.body: No persistent label or annotation renders below 12px. When space is tight, shorten the label or reveal detail on demand.

rules.name: The Financial Numeral Rule
rules.body: Scores, prices, changes, dates, and quantities use tabular numerals; aligned comparisons may use monospace.

rules.name: The One-H1 Rule
rules.body: Every route and material state has one page H1, followed by logical section headings.

rules.name: The Evidence Spine Rule
rules.body: Preserve Now → Drivers → Evidence → Definition → Audit unless a shorter page genuinely needs fewer steps.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface is structurally separated at rest. Elevation increases only because state or layering requires it.

dos: Do lead with the present market read and name the evidence that supports it.
Do show source, timestamp, coverage, missingness, and freshness near the evidence they qualify.
Do preserve a 44px mobile target for primary controls and a 12px absolute type floor.
Do make real scrollers labeled and keyboard-focusable, with visible overflow affordance.
Do keep human judgment editable in protected or operational workflows.
donts: Don't use microscopic labels, raw floating-point output, pure black layers, or decorative gradients as a substitute for hierarchy.
Don't communicate selection, condition, or chart meaning through color or hover alone.
Don't stack every desktop card into an unprioritized mobile wall.
Don't invent certainty, forecasts, performance claims, sources, or data that the backend does not establish.
Don't revive retired AAS routes; metals and crypto are the supported asset diagnostics.
